prompt.en: A United States visit checklist has the right destination but copied the participating-country voice-ID order. Which repair keeps both rows consistent with the lesson?

text.en: Use the United States visit pattern: the Canadian Basic row can stay, and the spoken ID starts with the Canadian call sign before the travel wording and area designator
Leave the voice-ID row in the participating-country order because both arrangements are international
Erase the qualification row because the identification format alone decides whether the visit is allowed
Use only a region label, because destination-specific identification is not part of the United States visit check

explanation.en: The United States visit rules in the lesson combine a qualification row with a distinct voice-identification pattern. Do not copy the CEPT order into that checklist.

prompt.en: A CEPT participating-country card is being checked before travel. Which combined change fixes the two most important travel rows?

text.en: Use the CEPT qualification level named in the lesson and put the visited-country prefix before the Canadian call sign in voice identification
Use the United States identification order whenever the operator is outside Canada
Skip the qualification row if the operator has already memorized the ITU region for the destination
Treat the message-purpose row as proof that the destination arrangement has been satisfied

explanation.en: For CEPT-style visits, the lesson keeps the qualification requirement and the voice-ID order as separate checks. A correct travel card has to satisfy both.

prompt.en: A net script contains a sponsor delivery item and cites a club handout as the rule source for international traffic. What should the control operator change?

text.en: Remove the non-amateur traffic and rely on the regulatory source identified by the lesson rather than a community handout
Keep the delivery item if the handout says the contact will be short
Leave the script unchanged because station certificates make all international messages equivalent
Change only the source citation, because message purpose is unrelated to international operation

explanation.en: International operation combines the content rule with the regulatory-source rule. A club document can help study, but it does not replace the rule source named by the bank.
